spec.name: fromStore
spec.description: Emits Output Items from the store: selection: <address>, or run: <ref> with output: <name>; optionally where: [...] and records: true.

spec.name: cas
pipeline
spec.description: Overrides the Pipeline Identity recorded in the RunManifest.

spec.name: tmpDir
spec.description: Scratch directory for content of unknown length on its way to an S3 member. Defaults to java.io.tmpdir.

spec.name: sweep
ageFloor
spec.description: A block younger than this is never trashed, whatever reaches it. At least 10m. Defaults to 14d.

spec.name: grace
spec.description: How long a trashed block waits before a sweep may delete it. Defaults to 14d.
What nf-blocks:sweep protects (DESIGN.md §19).

spec.name: asserted_by
spec.description: Name recorded in every asserted block. When unset it comes from Seqera Platform, NXF_BLOCKS_USER, git user.email, then "anonymous" (see docs/identity.md).

spec.name: resolve
spec.description: Store aliases to resolve, writable first. Defaults to every configured store.

spec.name: stores
location
spec.description: Where this member lives: a local directory or s3://<bucket>[/<prefix>].

spec.name: readOnly
spec.description: When true, nf-blocks:copy and the explorer never write to this member. Defaults to false; refused on the writable member.

scope.description: One store member per alias; the alias in lineage.store.location is the writable member.

spec.description: One store member per alias; the alias in lineage.store.location is the writable member.

spec.name: inputs
waitSeconds
spec.description: How long, in seconds, a completing run waits for the stat and hash of its inputs; a failed run waits at most 30 s of it. Inputs still being read then are listed without an address, with reason unfinished. A whole number, 0 or more. Defaults to 600.

spec.name: hash
spec.description: Hash each local input file (once per run, off the task threads) so runs that read the same bytes share its address; a remote input is never read. When false, inputs are listed by name, size, role and sample without an address. Defaults to true.
The files a run read from outside its work directory, recorded in its InputSet.

spec.name: index
path
spec.description: Overrides the SQLite index cache path. Defaults to a per-user cache file.
The derived SQLite index of the composition.

spec.name: nodeHash
spec.description: Hash declared outputs on the task node and publish their addresses from .command.cas. Defaults to fusion.enabled.

spec.name: snapshot
maxBytes
spec.description: A run rewrites its member Index Snapshot only while it is under this size. Defaults to 64 MB.
The Index Snapshot a member carries for nf-blocks:explore.
Content-addressed lineage store (nf-blocks).
